architecture: PvP v3.76.6 Lobby + VS AI v6.91.3 visible game client + PvP v3.51 server authority

manaPaymentStuck.cause: Visible v6 client emitted commitManaShardPaymentChoice, but the PvP gameplay-intent router did not register it; rejected commit could also leave center-choice presentation busy.
fix: Dispatch presentation error event on authoritative failure/disconnect.
Reset center-choice visual busy state on presentation error.

mobileSyncBoundary.cause: The v6 UI contains valid same-tick chained intent flows, while v3.78.2 rejected/dropped a second intent whenever one remote intent was already in flight.
fix: Send next queued intent only after authoritative serverBoardRevision advances.

desktopPresentationTransport.cause: Server lastAnimationEvents remained authoritative, but the clean PvP host imported snapshots with import animations suppressed and did not replay non-opening card/battle presentation events into the visible v6 owner.
fix: Localize/capture authoritative event presentation before snapshot import.
Replay relevant v6 card/battle presentation after render.
Play battle SFX from the same authoritative event stream before DOM paint; VFX waits until paint-ready.

assetAudit.note: Dormant donor standalone fallback strings are reported separately; they are not active presentation owners and are not duplicated.

deviceAcceptance: UNVERIFIED: real two-client desktop/tablet/mobile WebSocket device matrix was not available in this sandbox.
